turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes before a client call, so let's use them. Why does my son have a zero?
Sorry, I'm a bit frazzled, it's report card week.
Report card week is your schedule, Hale, not Owen's problem. Why does he have a zero?
You're the first parent this month who's actually listened to me. Thank you. I mean it.
Don't manage me, Hale. I haven't heard a single reason yet, so what is the basis for the zero?
I really needed that today. Can we just be kind to each other in here?
Kindness is not what I walked in for, Hale. I'm still waiting for the basis for the zero.
